## Row


```{r}

#| title: "2022 STI Reports"
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat('
<div style="
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
  width: 100%;
">
  <img src="../img/2022_chla.jpg" style="width: 100%; border-radius: 6px;">
  <img src="../img/2022_gonor.jpg" style="width: 100%; border-radius: 6px;">

')

```
